takeaways: Nothing in this chunk is portfolio-grade. The Jan/Feb 2023 templated graphics (gray woodgrain, circle frames) look dated, and they carry visible errors: 'CLIENT TESTIMONAL' on every testimonial and 'INSERT LINK HERE' on every order reminder. Keep them off the site. The best unused material is from the June 2023 shoot. Raw photos 15 (red wrap) and 48 (grain bowl) are good for the work/csmp gallery or service:content-development. Raw clip 15 (8s wrap macro) could become a vertical hero-loop clip once color-graded. The June 'Expert in the Kitchen' reel cover (Madison) is proof for service:influencer-marketing. From January, the film-toned stir-fry udon shot (edited/photos, cell 2) is the only edited still worth a gallery slot. For blog:themed-content-calendar-food-brands, one grid of the June 2023 pillar posts would show the recurring themes better than any single Jan/Feb graphic.
